title: Synthetic pilot fixture envelope (closed-object)
description: Closed-object envelope schema for the per-bug fixture set under `golden/synthetic_pillar4_pilot/`. Each fixture envelope describes a single bug from the pilot subset (m1 MSHR coalescing, m2 L1 sector model, m10 GTO scheduler) and points at the envelope's measured fingerprint plus the V1..V8 predicted fingerprint set. The fixture envelope IS NOT a gate-evaluation result; the synthetic-only contract forbids G3 verdicts, decision-quality, or PASS/FAIL labels in this directory tree, enforced both structurally (closed-object schema rejects unknown fields) and via the directory scan against the frozen `loop_a_alt4_forbidden_filename_patterns.toml` (which rejects filenames matching `*gate_verdict*`, `*top_*_match*`, `*bug_detection*passfail*`, `*g3_evaluation*`, `*decision_quality*`, `*pass_fail_ledger*`).

fixture_id.description: Stable identifier for the fixture envelope.

bug_id.description: Bug identifier from the pre-registered pilot subset. m1 covers MSHR coalescing depth; m2 covers L1 sector-model hit-rate; m10 covers GTO scheduler priority-inversion.

measured_fingerprint_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the measured_fingerprint.json for this bug (data_provenance == measured).

predicted_fingerprint_ref.description: Repo-relative path to the predicted_fingerprint.json for this variant.

predicted_fingerprint_refs.description: Exactly 8 predicted-fingerprint pointers, one per V1..V8 variant in the perturbation panel.

kernel_slug.description: The kernel slug the pilot fixture is anchored against. The 3-bug pilot is anchored against `rmsnorm_fwd_bf16`.

frozen_artifacts_ref.description: Repo-relative path to `frozen_artifacts.toml` registering this fixture as frozen pre-registration content.
